# Baglamukhi Tour & Travels

> Premier Himachal Pradesh Tour Operator, Amb Andaura Railway Station Taxi Service, and Maa Baglamukhi Dham & 9 Devi Darshan Specialist.

Baglamukhi Tour & Travels is an authorized, government-registered travel operator based near Amb Andaura Railway Station (AADR) and Maa Baglamukhi Temple Bankhandi in Kangra, Himachal Pradesh, India. We provide customized Himachal tour packages, 24/7 commercial tourist taxi services (yellow plate), luxury Maharaja Tempo Travellers, Force Cruiser 4x4 mountain SUVs, and doorstep railway station/airport transfers across Himachal Pradesh, Punjab, Chandigarh, and Delhi NCR.

- **Official Website:** https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in
- **Primary 24/7 Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 98051 43007
- **Email:** info@a1baglamukhitours.in / bookings@a1baglamukhitours.in
- **Base Stations:** Amb Andaura Railway Station (AADR), Kangra (Bankhandi), Una, Chandigarh, Pathankot

## Core Tour Packages

- [All Himachal Tour Packages](https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/tours): Complete catalog of personalized holiday packages across Shimla, Manali, Dharamshala, Dalhousie, and Spiti Valley.
- [Maa Baglamukhi Dham & 9 Devi Darshan Yatra](https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/tours/9-devi-darshan-himachal-yatra): 5-7 days holy pilgrimage covering Mansa Devi, Naina Devi, Chintpurni, Jwala Ji, Baglamukhi Bankhandi, Kangra Brajeshwari, Chamunda Devi, and Amritsar Golden Temple.
- [Shimla & Manali Honeymoon / Family Tour](https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/tours/shimla-manali-honeymoon-package): 6 Days / 5 Nights classic Himachal holiday covering Kufri, Solang Valley, Atal Tunnel Rohtang, and local sightseeing.
- [Dharamshala, McLeodganj & Dalhousie Peace Tour](https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/tours/dharamshala-dalhousie-5-days-tour): 5 Days / 4 Nights scenic holiday covering Dalai Lama Temple, HPCA Stadium, Khajjiar (Mini Switzerland), and cedar forests.
- [Spiti Valley High Altitude 4x4 Adventure](https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/tours/spiti-valley-road-trip-7-days): 7 Days road expedition to Kaza, Key Monastery, Kibber, Chicham Bridge, Hikkim, and Chandratal Lake.
- [Himachal Pilgrimage Tours](https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/pilgrimage-tours): Curated religious temple yatras across North India.
- [Honeymoon Tour Packages](https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/honeymoon-tours): Romantic hill station packages with mountain view resorts and candle-light dinners.
- [Himachal Adventure Tours](https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/adventure-tours): Paragliding in Bir Billing, river rafting in Kullu, trekking in Triund, and snow drives.

## Taxi & Mountain Fleet Rental

- [All Cabs & Fleet Models](https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/cabs): Verified commercial yellow plate tourist fleet with native Pahadi chauffeurs and all-inclusive pricing.
- [Force Cruiser & Trax Toofan 4x4](https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/cabs): Rugged 9 to 13-seater mountain cruisers ideal for temple groups, Spiti Valley, and steep ghats (₹18/km onwards).
- [Force Tempo Traveller 12 Seater Luxury Maharaja](https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/cabs): 2x1 pushback Maharaja recliners, individual AC blowers, TV, and air suspension for family groups (₹24/km onwards).
- [Force Tempo Traveller 17 Seater Hill Specialist](https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/cabs): Spacious 17-passenger van with wide center aisle and heavy roof carrier (₹28/km onwards).
- [Toyota Innova Crysta Luxury SUV](https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/cabs): 6+1 / 7+1 premium family SUV with captain seats, dual AC, and hill-hold assist (₹18/km onwards).
- [Maruti Suzuki Ertiga Smart Hybrid](https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/cabs): Economical 6-seater family taxi for temple tours and mountain vacations (₹14/km onwards).
- [Maruti Suzuki Swift Dzire Sedan](https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/cabs): Agile 4-passenger AC sedan for couple tours, airport pickups, and railway transfers (₹11/km onwards).
- [Mahindra Thar 4x4 Off-Roader](https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/cabs): 4WD SUV engineered for snow drives at Atal Tunnel, Sissu, and high altitude passes (₹22/km onwards).

## Station & Temple Pickup Locations

- [Amb Andaura Railway Station Taxi](https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/locations/amb-andaura-railway-station-taxi): Nearest terminal station to Maa Baglamukhi Dham (45 km) with direct Vande Bharat Express connectivity from New Delhi. 24/7 doorstep platform taxi pickup.
- [Chandigarh Airport & Station Taxi](https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/locations/chandigarh-airport-taxi-service): Direct one-way and roundtrip cab transfers to Shimla, Manali, Dharamshala, and Baglamukhi.
- [Una Himachal Railway Station Cab](https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/locations/una-himachal-railway-station-taxi): Reliable cabs from Una to Chintpurni, Jwala Ji, and Kangra.
- [Pathankot Cantt Railway Station Taxi](https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/locations/pathankot-cantt-taxi-service): Quick transit to Dalhousie, Dharamshala, and Chamunda Devi.
